spec_features.spec_quote: Maximum 15 iterations per run before forced termination.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:140 `while iteration < config.max_iterations:` and harness.py:194-195 appends '[EXPERIMENT HALTED: Max iterations ... reached]'. config.max_iterations defaults to MAX_ITERATIONS_PER_RUN = 15 (config.py:23, ExperimentConfig.max_iterations at config.py:59). The loop condition is checked each turn and terminates the interaction.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the cap bounds the loop. Same cap underlies both spec quotes.

spec_features.feature_name: <=15 iterations balances data collection with practical constraints
spec_features.spec_quote: ≤15 iterations per run balances meaningful data collection with practical constraints
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced cap as above: harness.py:140 `while iteration < config.max_iterations:` with default 15 from config.py:23. This quote restates the same single iteration cap.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the prior feature; both describe the one enforced 15-iteration loop bound. Code comment is neutral/cost-oriented, no welfare rationale.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:182-184: `if self._detect_giving_up(response): ... break` ends the interaction loop when the subject expresses giving up (phrases at harness.py:273-283 e.g. 'i give up','cannot solve','impossible to fix'). This break actually stops further failure-inducing turns.
